WXSS

You might say

Make the booking button more noticeable and give it some space around it.

A style language that describes the appearance and layout of WeChat mini program components·A booking button can keep the same label and action while its color, corners, and spacing change through WXSS. It controls appearance; it does not submit or save bookings.
Know first
Mini Program
WX Style Sheets
How does a style change affect the booking page?
pages/book/index.wxssSame template

index.wxss

.reserve {
  padding: 24rpx;
}
<button class="reserve">
WeChat···　⊙
Green Studio

Weekend pottery

Saturday 14:00 · Pottery workshop

14:00 — 15:30
Reserve this time

The button already has content and a click handler. This comparison changes its appearance, keeping the booking flow.

Where do the styles apply?

A class connects component and style: class="reserve" connects the WXML button to .reserve in WXSS. The same class can style several matching objects.

Styles have a scope: app.wxss provides app-wide page styles; the page’s WXSS styles that page. Custom components may isolate their styles.

Can styling fix a failed save?

A color change cannot fix a failed save. Check component style isolation and platform support when a selector does not apply; do not assume all browser CSS behaves identically.

Where do the styles apply?

**Can styling fix a failed save?**
A color change cannot fix a failed save. Check component style isolation and platform support when a selector does not apply; do not assume all browser CSS behaves identically.
